title: He, We, and the One Who
label: ch:pa-pronouns-and-relative
canDo: I can talk about somebody who is not present, say we, and describe a person instead of naming them.

payoff.summary: The absent third person, the missing we, and the relative. asi is the oddest gap in the inventory: the corpus teaches the first-person PLURAL future ending four separate times -- milaange, phir milaange, jaldi milaange, kall milaange -- so a reader has been saying we will meet for chapters without ever owning the word for we. jo completes the j- family and pairs with oh in the same two-ended shape as je ... taan.
payoff.note: The relative takes a track-local concept rather than the canonical RELATIVE-CLAUSE, which the spine stages at B2. What is taught is the A1 use the inventory names.
